notes.title: PUZZLE: CATS & DOGS - News
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33155491/079bdd1b7b5877524d786cd5204f31fc14e58500.png[/img]

[h1] Dear friends,	[/h1] 

[b] Soon my game will be released![/b] 

[b]Some information about the game:[/b] 
- At the first stage, the game will have 20 levels available!
If the game will interest the players, then we will try to add more levels!
- On the day of the release of the game, players will have a free add-on
(Puzzle Pack: Summer Cats)
DLC Puzzle Pack: Summer Cats includes:
10 new levels about the cats.

[b]The cost of the game: 1.99 USD [/b]
- In honor of the release of the game will be available a discount of 40%.

We already have ready-made Trading Cards for the game, as soon as the game reaches popularity, VALVE will approve us Trading Cards.

We will be grateful to everyone who will help us achieve popularity.

If you have suggestions for improving the game, write them in this topic or email: afbikstudio [@] mail.ru
